dict.Din salariul minim, pe loc neocupat: Of the minimum wage, per unfilled post
dict.Firmele cu cel puțin 50 de salariați tre: Companies with at least 50 employees must employ persons with disabilities in at least 4% of the average number of employees; otherwise they pay monthly, for each unfilled post, 50% of the gross minimum wage.
dict.Locurile obligatorii sunt luate aici ca: The required posts are taken here as the whole part of 4% (rounded down). Purchases of goods or services from authorised sheltered units are deducted from the amount owed.
dict.Pentru firmele cu cel puțin 50 de salari: For companies with at least 50 employees, month by month: from the average number of employees come the required posts (4%), the unfilled ones and the amount owed (50% of the minimum wage per post), minus the purchases from sheltered units; the status: not applicable, posts filled, covered or paid (in green), to pay (in yellow), deadline passed (in red).
dict.Suma se declară și se plătește până pe 2: The amount is declared and paid by the 25th of the following month. The threshold, the percentages and the rounding change by law: check them with your accountant.
